claim_review: Written for the actual adopted shoe and independently reviewed corresponding original photograph. Later adoption receipts supersede earlier candidate-stage status. HR051 limits apply to the two new real-source links; three old concept links excluded. Numeric sizes use owner-confirmed EU convention. Listed MOQ and selectors are not inventory proof. No unsupported test, certification, fiber composition, weight, source capability or stock claims. Only highlights and FAQ.
highlights: Low-top textile lace-up casual shoes with a continuous stitched toe surround and low sole profile. Conventional laces adjust the front, with pull loops at the tongue and heel. Black, Khaki and Dark Brown offer neutral choices through EU 39–48.

faq.question: Which color and EU size choices are listed?
faq.answers: Black: EU 39–48; Khaki: EU 39–48; Dark Brown: EU 39–48.

faq.question: Which upper details define this low-top style?
faq.answers: A continuous stitched toe surround, conventional lace panel and pull loops at the tongue and heel. The low collar and understated sole profile retain a simple everyday shape.

faq.question: What should I assess on a sample?
faq.answers: Adjust the laces with the intended socks, then check toe room, instep fit and heel hold before choosing the bulk EU size mix.

faq.question: What is the minimum order for the original style?
faq.answers: The listed original-style minimum is 2 pairs. Quantity pricing is shown on this page; logo and custom packaging proposals are quoted separately.

faq.question: How can I request a sample?
faq.answers: Send the selected color, EU size and delivery postcode for a sample quotation covering the pair, courier charge and proposed dispatch date.

faq.question: What should I send for logo or packaging requirements?
faq.answers: Send the logo artwork, preferred placement, packaging brief and order quantity. The proposal for this style will set out the applicable minimum, cost and sample process.

faq.question: How can I get a delivered quotation?
faq.answers: Send pair quantities by color and EU size, the destination postcode or port and the packaging request. The quotation separates product cost and freight and includes the proposed dispatch and transit schedule.
